positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Feed AI
positions.description:
Building AI models for LinkedIn Feed Recommendation:

Connected Content Retrieval for LinkedIn Feed:
– Technical lead for the Connected Content Retriever for LinkedIn’s home Feed, responsible for improving
candidate-selection and pre-ranking models. Most recent quarterly rollout increased Feed content time
spent (CTS) by 2.5%, with changes such as on-policy training, downstream-ranker objective alignment,
increased model capacity, infrastructure migration to GPU-based retrieval, and simplified reranking.
– Conducted offline and online experiments on ranker-to-retriever knowledge distillation, designed and
implemented post-level view time history, and content source affinity features.
• LLM-Based Feed Ranker:
– Built feature-to-prompt pipeline components for a Llama 3-based Feed engagement ranker; evaluated
feature encodings, including numeric precision for interaction-rate inputs.
– Repurposed model for retrieval usecase, evaluated embedding-extraction strategies using a single
special-token hidden state versus mean pooling across multiple special-token states.
• Small-Network Member Experience:
– Increased Feed CTS by 1.4% for members with ≤ 50 connections through cohort-specific tuning of
candidate pools, per-author limits, and objective weights.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Explainability
positions.description:
Model explainability at LinkedIn:

– Led a four-person group to shape model explainability at LinkedIn. Implemented an integrated gradients
library for per-instance feature attribution which was adopted by 10+ models across products.
– Partnered with model and product teams to translate attribution insights into production improvements,
including 2% higher gore-image classifier precision and a 1.1% increase in recruiter-search message send rate.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Multimedia and Content Quality AI
positions.description:
– Built an image-captioning model using a fine-tuned Inception V3 encoder and LSTM decoder, trained on
50K human-annotated LinkedIn images; Model achieved higher BLEU scores than the vendor API baseline
which was used for accessibility, search and ranking usecases.
– Developed a caption-quality classifier to filter inappropriate captions before displaying to members.
– Retrained the caption-supervised representation to reduce the embedding bottleneck from 1,024 to 50
dimensions for use in the Feed ranker.

projects.title: Read, Comprehend and Answer: A Neural Quiz Player - Master's thesis
projects.description: Working on open domain factoid question answering task. We treat this task as multi-class classification with reject option. We build neural network models which jointly performs task of content model(predicts correct answer) and buzzing model(predicts when to buzz). We also propose a method for learning entity representations and use this representations for factoid QA task.

projects.title: Link prediction in signed networks
projects.description: We look into two specific signed networks epinions and slashdots where signs show trust or distrust. We predict pair of nodes most likely to form future edges and the sign of the predicted edge.
